visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up of a roasted chicken being pulled apart by hands wearing white cloth gloves. Inside the cavity, dozens of whole, pale yellow garlic cloves and translucent onion pieces are visible among the dark, herb-infused stuffing. The skin of the chicken is a glossy, deep amber color, reflecting the bright, warm indoor lighting that emphasizes the moist texture of the meat. The background consists of a traditional woven bamboo basket, providing a rustic and organic context for the food presentation. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a large, cylindrical metal roasting drum where several whole chickens hang from metal hooks. A person wearing heavy black heat-resistant gloves and a red sleeve uses a metal tool to adjust the chickens. A bright orange silicone oven mitt is perched on the rim of the drum. The camera pans down to show the glowing orange charcoal at the bottom of the roaster, casting a warm, flickering light on the birds and the metallic walls of the oven. (3) Returning to a tabletop setting, hands in clear plastic gloves tear into a large drumstick, revealing the white, steaming meat beneath the crispy, thin skin. Clear juices and fat drip onto a wooden or bamboo surface below. The lighting remains bright and focused on the chicken, showcasing the steam rising from the hot meat. The camera uses a medium close-up shot to capture the physical action of deconstructing the bird. (4) The chicken is shown being split open further to reveal a large amount of green herbs, identified in text as lemon leaves, mixed with a dark, finely chopped spice paste. A pair of metal scissors cuts through the meat to show the depth of the seasoning. The background is slightly blurred, keeping the focus on the intricate details of the stuffing and the various textures of the cooked poultry. (5) A piece of chicken skin and meat is dipped into a small clear plastic cup filled with golden chicken oil, then into a small yellow ceramic dish containing a fine, tan-colored seasoning powder. The camera captures the powder adhering to the glistening surface of the chicken. The movements are deliberate and slow to highlight the sensory appeal of the condiments. (6) A man in a red polo shirt with a logo and black gloves stands behind a counter where multiple white cardboard takeaway boxes are lined up. He retrieves a roasted chicken from the drum. The background shows a menu board with colorful sections and blurred figures of customers standing in a bright, modern shop environment. The lighting here is typical of a retail food establishment, using bright overhead artificial lights. (7) The final phase shows the exterior storefront of the shop at night. The large red and yellow sign reads 越南烤雞王 with a stylized chicken logo. The street outside is dark, but the shop is brilliantly illuminated by neon and fluorescent lights, making it stand out in the urban environment. A person's hand holds a white plastic bag with the same logo in front of the shop.
